artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape across water with various architectural structures sketched in detail. The skyline is clear against the sky, with ships and reflections visible. The etching uses precise linework and a minimalist color palette, primarily warm earth tones. The scene conveys tranquility and expansiveness.

artworks.title: Lagoon: Noon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.38 x 20.32 cm (4 7/8 x 8 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 13.34 x 20.32 cm (5 1/4 x 8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays several sailing ships anchored in a body of water, possibly a harbor or river. A group of human figures is seen on a small section of land or a dock. The horizon is positioned high in the composition, showing a faint outline of distant land and structures. The artwork is created in a sketch-like style with detailed etching strokes, emphasizing fluidity and movement. The color scheme is primarily sepia or faded ink, creating a serene atmosphere. The central focus is on a large ship with partially blurred sails.

artworks.title: Fish-Shop, Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.86 x 22.23 cm (5 1/16 x 8 3/4 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 13.49 x 22.23 cm (5 5/16 x 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban street scene featuring an alleyway and architectural elements. The drawing shows a view of a street, leading through an archway to an alley. In the foreground, steps lead down into the scene, with architectural details framing the path. The alley is bustling with activity. The etched lines are fine and closely woven, creating detailed textures reflecting the stonework and woodwork of buildings. The architecture includes a visible facade with an arch and inner rooms seen through large openings resembling windows, giving a glimpse of objects or furnishings inside. The overall tone of the drawing is muted with a focus on light and shadows capturing the mood of a historical city street.

artworks.title: Little Salute
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 8.41 x 20.96 cm (3 5/16 x 8 1/4 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 10.16 x 20.96 cm (4 x 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront cityscape viewed across a body of water. Buildings are visible, with a prominent dome in the center-right. The horizon is low, emphasizing the water. The artwork features delicate, sketch-like lines suggesting a sense of lightness. The color scheme is monochromatic, with sepia and black tones. Tonal variations imply reflections in the water and add depth to the structures.

artworks.title: Old Women
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed to plate): 12.7 x 20.2 cm (5 x 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a street scene showing a group of people outside a building. The drawing depicts individuals, including adults and a child, in front of a storefront or entrance with large open doors. The figures are sketched with light lines and minimal detail. On the left, there is a solitary figure standing apart, providing a sense of depth in the composition. The architectural details are suggested with simple lines, emphasizing human interaction over setting clarity, giving a spontaneous feel to the observation.

artworks.title: Wheelwright
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cluttered, rustic interior with various objects and structures. The drawing depicts the inside of a large barn or workshop. Wooden beams stretch across the ceiling, with details of wheels, planks, and boards in the foreground. On the right, there are shapes resembling tools, benches, or storage areas. The composition has strong perspective, emphasizing shadows and forms with a hatching technique. The style suggests an artist interested in structure and detail.

artworks.title: Temple
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The etching displays a street view featuring a large, multi-storied building. The perspective is slightly angled, enhancing the depth. The horizon is not prominent, as the buildings extend vertically. A horse-drawn cart is in front of the building, with a gas lamp nearby. A tree is on the right. The brushstrokes are subtle and minimalistic. The color scheme is monochromatic, using the paper's tone and black ink for contrast. Additional faintly sketched buildings appear in the distance.

artworks.title: Lobster-Pots
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on  Asian laid paper
artworks.description: A collection of lobster pots in the lower section of the image. The scene extends to an expanse of water establishing the horizon line. The horizon is clear, with simple lines indicating distant objects. The sketch is in a minimalist ink style using fine, linear strokes for texture and form. The color palette is monochromatic with natural tones of paper and dark ink lines.

artworks.title: Lobster-Pots
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a group of wicker baskets intricately drawn on the ground. The sky and landscape are depicted in a sketch-like style, with delicate line work. The baskets' woven patterns are detailed, and the overall color palette is monochromatic. In the background, there are vague shapes hinting at distant structures or natural elements, enhancing the portrayal of rural life.

artworks.title: Little Court
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene in front of a building. The drawing depicts a rustic building facade with large windows, some of which appear open. Below, there is a large archway or entryway. In the foreground, several figures are depicted, along with what appears to be a cart. The composition is minimalistic, focusing on form and layout rather than intricate details. The use of lines is loose, giving the impression of a rapid sketch or an etching.

artworks.title: Drury Lane
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view looking into a covered outdoor area resembling an archway. In the background, buildings and people are visible. The lines and strokes give a sense of depth without detailed shading. The color scheme is monochromatic, with dark lines on a light beige background. Sketched figures are in the foreground, while more figures are seen in the distance near the buildings.

artworks.title: Regent's Quadrant
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The etching depicts a busy urban street scene with carriages and individuals. The vantage point is low, showing a large overhanging structure supported by a column on the left side. Horizontal lines dominate the upper quarter of the image, and there is no distinct horizon visible. The brushstrokes are loose and sketch-like, with expressive cross-hatching and dynamic lines capturing the energy of the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing black, brown, and beige tones. Figures and carriages are detailed with an impressionistic touch, creating a lively urban setting. In the distance, more buildings and activity are suggested, showing the vibrancy of city life.

artworks.title: Regent's Quadrant
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a lot of activity, seen from a slightly elevated perspective. There is an architectural structure with columns in the foreground. The style is sketch-like, with expressive line work portraying movement and life. Fine lines and hatching depict figures and carriages throughout the scene. Close to us, there are sketchy people and carriages with quick, fluid strokes. In the distance, more figures and a building can be seen. The horizon is hidden by the architectural element at the top. The color palette is sepia.

artworks.title: The Smithy
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist's studio with various objects and furniture scattered throughout the room. The studio has a high, slanting roof textured with cross-hatching lines. A large window on the left side lets in light, illuminating the space. Items such as tables, chairs, easels, and artworks are present. The room appears busy and chaotic with many sketchy lines creating a sense of creativity. Delicate shading adds depth and detail to the scene.

artworks.title: The Smithy
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of a cluttered workshop with large windows on the left side. The color palette consists of sepia tones, giving the scene an aged, monochromatic look. In the foreground, there are several tables and various tools scattered across the floor. A figure is near the center, surrounded by equipment and furniture. The ceiling reaches upwards, slanting slightly to the right, where the overall texture of the image is rough and densely detailed, suggesting shadows and depth in the workshop setting.

artworks.title: Dordrecht
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows sailing boats at various distances on the water. Two larger boats with masts and visible sails are closest to us, one to the right and one to the left. The horizon, with the details of a shoreline, buildings, and trees, is visible as a thin line. The horizon aligns with the tops of structures in the distance, emphasizing a coastal settlement. The artwork is a line drawing with light, hasty brushstrokes, creating a sense of sketch-like immediacy and fluidity. The color palette is primarily natural tones with the dark ink lines providing contrast.

artworks.title: Boats, Dordrecht
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows sailboats on a body of water. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a wide scene with an implied horizon. The lines are delicate and sketch-like, depicting water and sails with minimal detail. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black on a light sepia background. Faint architectural elements are suggested in the distance.

artworks.title: Cottage Door
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch features a full-body depiction of a person standing, with another figure faintly visible in the background. The standing figure is slightly off-center to the right, with one foot in front of the other. The facial features are not detailed, but the figure is facing forward with short, possibly curly hair or a brim of a hat. The figure is wearing a long, loose coat. Another figure is seen sitting or crouching lower to the ground towards the center bottom of the image. The background is roughly sketched and may represent a wall or structure to the right, with shadowing behind the figures and loose hatching to depict texture or shadows on the ground. No jewelry or held objects are visible on the individuals.

artworks.title: The Village Sweet-Shop
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of multiple children gathered in the entrance of a rustic building. The children's bodies are partially shown, some standing and others crouching or sitting. Facial features are not detailed, but their heads are outlined. The children wear simple clothing. The setting is outdoors with a pebble-strewn ground. Next to the children, there is a wooden plank leaning against the wall with a small, gridded window filled with objects. The background is minimalistic focusing on wooden elements and wall texture.

artworks.title: The Seamstress
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of two women positioned partially in profile facing each other. One woman is standing while the other is seated and appears to be focused on some handiwork. The standing woman wears a large hat and a long-sleeved jacket or dress with vertical stripes, while the seated woman wears a long gown with horizontal stripes and is depicted holding some work in her hands. In the background, there is a table with vases or small vessels atop it, set in a sparsely decorated interior space.

artworks.title: The Towing-Path
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features fine lines drawn with ink pen. The horizon shows faint vegetation and structures. The sparse brushstrokes suggest trees, figures, and possibly horses. There is a simple depiction of water with horizontal lines suggesting its texture. The color palette is minimal, with natural paper tone and dark ink.

artworks.title: Saint James's Park
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a tree with branches and leaves extending in various directions. The background is not clearly defined. Loose brushstrokes depict movement and liveliness. The sketch is mostly monochrome with varying line thickness for depth and texture. Faint outlines of figures and animals suggest a bustling scene. The color palette is primarily soft beige with darker sketch lines for contrast.

artworks.title: Old-Clothes Shop, No.I
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The largest objects in the drawing are a rack of hanging clothes and a figure seated in what seems to be a doorway surrounded by shadow. The color palette includes black ink on a beige paper. The clothes are displayed prominently on the left at the top of a shelf lined with various indistinct objects. The seated figure is on the right, partially enclosed by a darker outlined area that implies a doorframe or threshold, providing depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Old-Clothes Shop, No.II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene showing an entrance and its surroundings. The image depicts a quiet scene in a residential or commercial setting. In the center, a set of stairs leads to a darkened entryway with a standing figure by the side. To the right, there are various framed objects and an ornate decoration suggesting an interior view. On the left, a group of smaller figures are sketched in lighter detail. The drawing features loose, flowing lines giving it an impressionistic feel.
